newsitem.title: USA: TCI mulls new stock tied to performance.
newsitem.headline: TCI mulls new stock tied to performance.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said Tuesday evening that it is considering the creation of a new series of its common stock intended to reflect the performance of TCI Group's international and non-cable assets.
The company said that to do this, it is considering amending the recently approved Telephony Group tracking stock to expand that group to track such assets.
The assets would include @Home, Tele-Communications International Inc, United Video Satellite and others, TCI said.

A statement from the company said that the tracking stock may be issued through an exchange offer whereby the company's shareholders would have the opportunity to exchange their TCI Group stock for tracking stock of the new group.
Calls to TCI offices in Colorado were not immediately returned Tuesday evening.
In the same statement, the cable giant also said it plans to roll out a basic digital product to 75 to 90 percent of its homes passed by the end of 1997.
It said that beginning in May, it would launch its basic digital product with an additional 40 video channels and 14 audio channels.
It would fund said the upgrade and roll-out of digital TV with internally generated funds.
